name: zendesk-mcp-server
description: Search and manage Zendesk tickets, users, organizations, and Help Center articles.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Zendesk account. Read-only mode is on by default: Claude can look things up but can't create, change, or delete anything. Turn it off in the extension settings only if you need Claude to make changes.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get a specific ticket by ID

tools.name: get_ticket_comments
tools.description: Get the conversation on a ticket: every public reply and internal note, oldest first, as plain text with author names

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get a specific user by ID

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get a specific organization by ID

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Get a specific group by ID

tools.name: get_macro
tools.description: Get a specific macro by ID

tools.name: get_view
tools.description: Get a specific view by ID

tools.name: get_trigger
tools.description: Get a specific trigger by ID

tools.name: get_automation
tools.description: Get a specific automation by ID

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a specific Help Center article by ID

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Help Center articles by keyword. Returns titles, links and matching snippets; use get_article for an article's full text

tools.name: get_help_center_structure
tools.description: Get the Help Center's categories, sections and subsections as a tree, with article counts and last-updated dates per section, to see which areas are thin or stale

tools.name: create_article
tools.description: Create a new Help Center article

tools.name: update_article
tools.description: Update an existing Help Center article

tools.name: support_info
tools.description: Get information about Zendesk Support configuration

tools.name: export_tickets
tools.description: Export every ticket matching a Zendesk search to a JSON Lines file in the export folder, one ticket per line, for analyzing more tickets than fit in a conversation. Large exports take several calls: while done is false, call again with only the returned resume value.

subdomain.title: Zendesk subdomain
subdomain.description: The part before .zendesk.com in your Zendesk address. For https://acme.zendesk.com, enter acme.

email.title: Zendesk email
email.description: The email address you sign in to Zendesk with.

api_token.title: Zendesk API token
api_token.description: Create one in Zendesk Admin Center under Apps and integrations > APIs > Zendesk API.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: When on, Claude can only look things up. Turn off to let Claude create, change, and delete Zendesk data.

allow_admin_role.title: Allow granting admin role
allow_admin_role.description: Lets Claude make users Zendesk admins. Leave off unless you need it.

export_dir.title: Export folder
export_dir.description: Where ticket exports are saved. To analyze exports in Cowork, pick the folder you use with Cowork.
